---
title: "Titanic - dateRangeInput"
format:
  dashboard:
    logo: logo.png
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)
df <- read_csv("https://bryantstats.github.io/math421/data/titanic_final.csv") |>
  drop_na(Age, Embarked) |>
  mutate(date = mdy(date), Survived = factor(Survived, labels = c("No", "Yes")), Pclass = factor(Pclass))

# Shown instead of a plot when the inputs leave no rows
empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |>
    layout(title = list(text = "No passengers match these inputs.", y = 0.5))
}
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

The sinking of the Titanic is one of the most infamous shipwrecks in history. Some groups of people were more likely to survive than others. Use the input below to change the plots here and the table on the **Data** page.

The dates in this data are made up for practice; they are not real.

```{r}
dateRangeInput("dates", "Date range",
               start = min(df$date), end = max(df$date),
               min = min(df$date), max = max(df$date))
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Age density
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Survival by class
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Data used in the plots (filtered by the inputs on the Plots page)
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive({
  df |>
    filter(date >= input$dates[1], date <= input$dates[2])
})

output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  p <- ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = Age, color = Survived)) +
    geom_density()
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  p <- ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = Pclass, fill = Survived)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill") +
    labs(y = "Proportion")
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$tbl <- renderDT({
  filtered() |>
    select(date, Name, Sex, Age, Pclass, Embarked, Survived) |>
    datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
})
```
